svg.metadata: {"story":"Samuel","act":10,"chapter":"Ch.10 · David Anointed","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Samuel anoints David the youngest son of Jesse in Bethlehem, and the Spirit of the Lord comes upon him from that day.
